title: Every turn was told to run in a directory no member has
foundBy: session agent, after a cs-sandbox fix stopped masking it
details:
cs-campaign passed `-d /workspace` to every agent turn, from `startTurn` on the host and from the member-side dispatcher. No member has that directory: `ls -ld /workspace` in a Firecracker sandbox reports ENOENT, and the string appears nowhere in cs-sandbox.

It did no visible harm because every adapter fell back. `tmux new-session -c` starts the session in its own working directory when the path does not exist, so claude and codex turns ran in $HOME while the argument said otherwise. The opencode driver bound its session to the directory it was given, and used to hide that behind `cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null || cd "$HOME"`.

When cs-sandbox stopped hiding it, opencode honoured the path and failed every prompt on the session with `PlatformError: NotFound: FileSystem.realPath (/workspace)`. The campaign then ran its whole restart ladder against members that could not answer.

The comment on the constant also claimed the value came from the sandbox layer. It did not.
